HOTEL SOL DE MARINA ****
Carrer de la Platja 14, 07400 Alcúdia, Mallorca, Spain
Reservations & contracting: contratos@soldemarina.example
ACCOMMODATION AGREEMENT – SUMMER 2027
Between Hotel Sol de Marina ("the Hotel") and SunnyBreaks Holidays Ltd ("the Operator"). Validity:
01/05/2027 to 31/10/2027. All prices are NET in EURO, per room per night, including breakfast
unless stated otherwise, and including VAT.
1. Room types
(cid:127) Double Standard – 1 to 2 adults, max 1 child (3 persons total)
(cid:127) Double Sea View – 1 to 2 adults, max 1 child (3 persons total)
(cid:127) Family Room (two connecting areas) – min 2 / max 4 adults, max 2 children, maximum 4 persons
2. Seasons
Low: 01/05 – 14/06 Mid: 15/06 – 14/07 High: 15/07 – 31/08 Shoulder: 01/09 – 31/10
3. Rates (EUR, net, per room per night)
Room / Board Low Mid High Shoulder
Double Standard – BB 95 120 155 105
Double Standard – HB 125 150 185 135
Double Sea View – BB 110 135 170 120
Double Sea View – HB 140 165 200 150
Family Room – BB 150 185 240 165
Family Room – HB 200 235 290 215
* All Inclusive available on request at a supplement of EUR 70 per room per night over the HB rate
(Family Room: EUR 110 per room per night).
Minimum stay: 3 nights. During High season the minimum stay is 5 nights.

[page 2]
4. Children (sharing with two full-paying adults, 3rd/4th bed)
Infants 0 – 1.99 years: free of charge (cot on request).
Children 2 – 11.99 years: EUR 25 per night.
Teens 12 – 17.99 years: EUR 45 per night.
5. Allocation and release
The Hotel guarantees the following rooms per night: Double Standard 10, Double Sea View 4,
Family Room 6. Release period: 14 days prior to arrival; unsold rooms return to the Hotel.
6. Cancellation
Cancellations received more than 30 days before arrival: no charge. 15 to 30 days: 50% of the total
stay. 14 days or less, or no-show: 100%.
7. Early booking offer
10% discount for bookings confirmed on or before 31/01/2027, valid for stays 01/05/2027 –
31/10/2027, all boards. Not combinable with other offers.
8. Taxes and payment
Balearic Sustainable Tourism Tax (EUR 2.20 per person per night) is NOT included and is payable
by guests directly at the Hotel. Payment: by bank transfer within 30 days of guest departure.
Signed for the Hotel: M. Ferrer, Revenue Manager Date: 18/11/2026
